decls.name: Prop32CyclotomicBase_totally_real

paper_span.quote: Then the fields \(L_i\) are totally real and linearly disjoint,

decls.rationale: The totally-real half of Proposition 3.2(1): the compositum \(M = L_1\cdots L_\ell\) of the cyclic cubic subfields is totally real.

decls.name: Prop32CyclotomicBase_degree
decls.rationale: The degree consequence of Proposition 3.2(2): \(\mathrm{Gal}(M/\mathbb{Q}) \cong (\mathbb{Z}/3\mathbb{Z})^\ell\) gives \([M:\mathbb{Q}] = 3^\ell\).

decls.name: Prop32CyclotomicBase_galois_elementary_abelian
decls.rationale: The group-structure content of Proposition 3.2(2): \(\mathrm{Gal}(M/\mathbb{Q})\) is elementary abelian of exponent 3 — stated in Lean as commutativity together with \(\sigma^3 = 1\).

decls.name: Prop32CyclotomicBase_relative_degree
decls.rationale: Proposition 3.2(2), relative half: \(\mathrm{Gal}(M/F) \cong (\mathbb{Z}/3\mathbb{Z})^{\ell-1}\) for the cyclic cubic field `F` cut out by \(\chi = \chi_1\cdots\chi_\ell\).

decls.name: Prop32CyclotomicBase_discriminant
decls.rationale: Proposition 3.2(3): with \(D = \prod_i r_i\), the base field satisfies \(|D_F| = D^2\) — the conductor–discriminant computation (both nontrivial characters of `F` have conductor `D`).

decls.name: Prop32CyclotomicBase_unramified
decls.rationale: Proposition 3.2(4): \(M/F\) is everywhere unramified — forced by \(|D_M| = |D_F|^{[M:F]}\) via the tower formula, plus total reality at the infinite places.
